MT1 → MT2: Build an economy that supports your tower

Make Workshop upgrades affordable while collecting enough modules and regions for MT2.

What to understand at MT1

Workers
Assignments that repeat supported tasks. Read each assignment’s requirements and output so that it helps your current bottleneck.
Factory producer
A crafted source of recurring resources. Building producers turns part of your progression into steady income rather than relying exclusively on combat rewards.
Backups
A military perk intended to preserve a baseline of module progress through later promotions. Check its current wording before choosing it.

What you are working toward

  • Check the MT2 module and region objectives in Headquarters. The supplied older table lists 25 maximized modules and 5 regions; the in-game counters take priority.
  • Maintain a reliable farming blueprint while expanding permanent production.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an editorial synthesis of the supplied community research. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Rebuild the useful part of your Workshop

    First restore the damage and survival modules that made the previous tier work. You need a dependable source of income before spreading purchases across your entire collection. Test on a familiar region so you can tell when the tower is ready to move forward. [S03] [S04]

  2. Raise building limits when they block production

    Use the Construction Firm to improve the buildings needed for your next step. A building upgrade is valuable when it opens a recipe, capacity or upgrade you can use; it is not automatically the best purchase simply because it is available. [S04]

  3. Start a small Factory production chain

    Choose an accessible producer recipe. Inspect its ingredients, make the required machines, and work backward to the ores and intermediate materials you need. If one ingredient is always missing, improve that stage first. Keeping every machine busy matters less than supplying the ingredient that is holding up the next producer. [S04]

  4. Support the Factory with the Mine

    Develop mining and refining together so that higher-tier ingredients become possible. Avoid spending all available materials on a future recipe while your present production remains unable to replace them. Assign workers to supported repetitive tasks that you otherwise keep returning to manually. [S04] [S05]

  5. Expand regions and finish the module counter

    Alternate combat pushes with collecting missing modules. When the tower is strong enough for the required regions, direct more resources toward maximizing the extra modules Headquarters requests. A module does not have to remain in your combat blueprint to contribute to a collection objective. [S02] [S06]

If you are stuck

Enemies are easy, but upgrades take forever

Treat this as an income problem. Compare the time needed for another producer or production upgrade with the time spent repeating tower tests.

The Factory feels complicated

Pick one concrete item to craft next. Follow only that recipe’s chain until it is complete, then choose the next bottleneck.

Ready to move on?

  • Headquarters shows the MT2 module and region objectives complete.
  • Your income can rebuild your core combat modules after promotion.
After the promotion

MT2 is a good point to broaden your sources of modules. Challenges and Laboratory experiments can fill gaps that ordinary region farming does not. [S02] [S05]
